caption: The drawing depicts a single brown boot, oriented with the toe pointing to the right and the shaft upright. The word "REPAIRING" is written vertically down the shaft of the boot in large, bold, black capital letters. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or details present. The overall composition centers the boot in the image, making it the sole focus.
